Hi Helen / Emma / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick read and the specific asks. I wanted to respond to the two points you raised so we can converge quickly:

SLA credits (section 4.2)
- Your ask: a higher cumulative cap (40%) for repeated outages in a 90-day window.
- Our proposed compromise: keep the single-incident cap at 25% of the monthly invoice, but add an escalation clause: if the same service experiences three qualifying incidents within any rolling 90-day period, the cumulative credit for that 90-day window may be increased up to 40% (not to exceed the invoice sum for the affected services).
- Draft wording (suggested replacement for 4.2.c):
  "In the event of three or more qualifying outages for the same service within any rolling 90-day period, Supplier's cumulative credit liability for that 90-day period shall not exceed forty percent (40%) of the total charges for the affected services during such period."

Data residency
- We can support US-only production residency on Dedicated instances in the us-west-2 and us-east-1 footprints. We'll add a short exhibit to the order form confirming the region and the operational controls (KMS in customer account, audit log retention).

Exhibit ordering
- We updated the order form v3 to align exhibit numbers and included a page one table of exhibits to make PO references explicit.

I’ll incorporate these language tweaks into the annotated PDF and re-attach. If that looks good, we can move to DocuSign.

FYI: forwarding the draft legal text here for easier markup.

Best,
